summary: Phase 2 GEOINT platform (LIVE mode with real CDSE) validated. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed (status live, real S2 product IDs from imagery search, existing change events with real S1/S2 imagery IDs, change detail, jobs diagnostics.mode='real' for both optical and SAR jobs including sar_polygons=6/sar_threshold=2.0, and HTML briefing report). Frontend: MODE shows LIVE (green), DEMO_DATA badge absent, LIVE-Rome-Test AOI displays 50 real observations and 7 real change events on map, change-detail panel exposes export-report-btn pointing to /api/v1/changes/{id}/report with target=_blank. To conserve CDSE quota, no new live change-detection jobs were triggered; validation reused the existing 4 real jobs + 7 events in Mongo. Live change-detection test scaffold is included but gated behind RUN_LIVE_CD=1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large; the inline HTML report template (in /changes/{id}/report) mixes presentation and business logic — consider extracting to a Jinja2 template file for maintainability.
Endpoint GET /api/v1/aois/{aoi_id}/change-events returns 404 (correct route is /aois/{aoi_id}/changes as GeoJSON). If future consumers expect the former, add an alias or document clearly.
geom_json in the HTML report is built with str(dict).replace("'", '"') — this is fragile for nested objects containing quotes. Use json.dumps() for safety and correctness.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth); CDSE creds in backend/.env
seed_data_creation: Reused pre-seeded AOI b53996b3-51bb-47e6-b50e-c6f190c9ef16 (LIVE-Rome-Test) with 50 observations, 4 jobs, 7 change events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live change-detection E2E is skipped by default to conserve CDSE processing units. Set RUN_LIVE_CD=1 before pytest to trigger a real optical run against LIVE-Rome-Test AOI. Existing jobs already confirm diagnostics.mode='real' and SAR pipeline (sar_polygons, sar_threshold) diagnostics are populated end-to-end.
